posts.title: Bayesians vs frequentists
posts.description: When I first heard that statistics had a long-running dispute between “Bayesians” and “frequentists”, I was confused: this is math; how can there be long-running disputes? In math, things are proven; the losing side loses definitively and moves on. So what gives? It turns out the dispute is about the social role of the statistician, not the math itself.
